import numpy as np

# Create identity matrix
I = np.eye(3)
v = np.array([1, 2, 3])

# Multiply
result = I @ v
print(f'I @ v = {result}')
print(f'Same as v? {np.array_equal(result, v)}')

# Stats
print(f'Mean: {v.mean():.2f}')
print(f'Std: {v.std():.2f}')
